images.caption: In the tent of a blind kete (ethnic group) shaman (jenisejostjak). Next to the shaman, who predicted a great war, a helper is sitting with a Russian bridal crown on her head. It is made from copper, and adorned with crosses. One of the pictures from the journey to Siberia between Aug. 2 and Oct. 26, 1913. Fridtjof Nansen continued his trans-Siberian journey in a small steamer up the Yenisei River to Yeniseisk.
